title: Derivaciones matemáticas justificadas — D13 Cámaras, lentes y lenguaje cinematográfico

records.name: Perspective projection
starting_principles: z>0; FOV in (0,π).
Aspect ratio and camera convention declared.

derivation.justification: Similar triangles in the pinhole camera project a point by dividing by depth.
Scale normalized coordinates by focal length in pixels.
Derive focal scale from right-triangle geometry of the image plane.

assumptions: Aspect ratio and camera convention declared.
records.result: Perspective follows pinhole projection and similar triangles.
limits: Clipping and lens distortion are separate stages.

records.name: Orthographic projection
starting_principles: Bounds nonzero; camera basis orthonormal.
Aspect ratio handled in projection bounds.

derivation.justification: Apply constant scale independent of depth.

assumptions: Aspect ratio handled in projection bounds.
records.result: Orthographic projection is an affine map of view-space x/y.

records.name: Field of view
starting_principles: FOV in (0,π); aspect>0.
Vertical/horizontal/diagonal convention explicit.

derivation.justification: Use right triangle from camera center to image-plane edge.
Relate horizontal and vertical FOV through aspect ratio.

records.result: FOV and focal scale are linked by image-plane geometry.
limits: FOV is not focal length in mm without sensor size.

records.name: Depth of field approximation
starting_principles: s,s_focus>f; N>0; f>0.
Distances measured from principal plane.

derivation.justification: Solve image distance for the focused subject.
Substitute image distances and simplify the defocus circle under paraxial assumptions.

records.result: Blur-circle approximation follows from thin-lens image geometry and aperture diameter.
limits: Real lenses include aberrations and pupil magnification.

records.name: Look-at orientation
starting_principles: target differs from camera; up_ref not parallel to forward.
Handedness and camera local-forward convention fixed.

derivation.justification: Aim local forward axis at target.
Convert orthonormal frame to orientation quaternion.

assumptions: target differs from camera; up_ref not parallel to forward.
Handedness and camera local-forward convention fixed.
records.result: Look-at derives camera orientation from an orthonormal frame.
limits: Parallel up/forward requires alternate up reference.

records.name: Dolly
starting_principles: Path in world frame; time/speed profile declared.
Path differentiable or sampled.

derivation.justification: Translate camera center along a path.
Reparameterize by arc length for controlled speed.

assumptions: Path in world frame; time/speed profile declared.
records.result: Dolly is camera translation along a designed trajectory.

records.name: Truck / pan / tilt
starting_principles: Translations have L; angles radians; quaternions unitary.
Multiplication order fixed.
assumptions: Translations have L; angles radians; quaternions unitary.
records.result: Camera movement combines local translation and quaternion rotation.

records.name: Crane / jib
starting_principles: Key times increasing; positions in world frame.
Spline tangents have units L/T if t is seconds.
assumptions: Key times increasing; positions in world frame.
Spline tangents have units L/T if t is seconds.
records.result: Crane motion is a time-parametrized spline path.

records.name: Orbit
starting_principles: r>0; θ in radians; same world frame.
Orbit axis and target declared.
assumptions: r>0; θ in radians; same world frame.
records.result: Orbit is a circular/elliptical camera trajectory.
limits: Moving targets require updating center and orientation.

records.name: Camera shake
starting_principles: τ>0; amplitudes bounded; seed fixed.
Position amplitude L; angular amplitude radians.
assumptions: Position amplitude L; angular amplitude radians.
records.result: Camera shake is bounded noise with temporal envelope.
limits: High-frequency/unbounded noise causes aliasing and unstable framing.

records.name: Follow camera
starting_principles: λ>0 s⁻¹; Δt in seconds.
Offset shares world unit/frame with subject.

derivation.justification: Solve exactly for constant target over Δt.
Express exact solution as frame-rate-independent interpolation.

assumptions: Offset shares world unit/frame with subject.
records.result: Exponential follow is the exact solution of a first-order linear tracking system.
limits: Target discontinuities may require spring-damper or velocity constraints.

records.name: Motion blur
starting_principles: Shutter interval nonnegative; samples share color/exposure convention.
Scene evaluable at sample times or motion vectors valid.

derivation.justification: Define pixel radiance over shutter time.
Sensor integrates radiance over exposure interval.
Approximate integral by normalized temporal samples.

assumptions: Shutter interval nonnegative; samples share color/exposure convention.
Scene evaluable at sample times or motion vectors valid.
records.result: Motion blur is temporal averaging over shutter interval.
limits: Single-frame blur is approximate at disocclusions.

records.name: Shot continuity
starting_principles: Subject identities and action axis defined.
Camera projection and right vector consistent.

derivation.justification: Maintain screen direction and eyeline across cuts.

assumptions: Subject identities and action axis defined.
Camera projection and right vector consistent.
records.result: Continuity can be checked through projected subject ordering and eyeline direction.
limits: A cinematographic convention, not a universal mathematical law.

records.name: Camera beat sheet
starting_principles: Key times increasing; FOV in (0,π).
Position and target share frame.

derivation.justification: Define time-coded camera and lens keys.

records.result: A beat sheet becomes synchronized camera position, orientation and lens curves.
limits: FOV interpolation is not identical to focal-length interpolation.

records.name: SDF smooth union
starting_principles: a,b,k have L; k>0.
SDF inputs share frame/sign convention.

derivation.justification: Exact union uses minimum of signed distance fields.
Subtract smooth correction near equal distances.

records.result: Smooth minimum rounds the hard union near the intersection.
limits: Changes local volume and is not exact SDF in blend region.

records.name: Curvas de cámara con marco estable
starting_principles: Tangents nonzero; antiparallel case uses fallback axis.
Handedness and up convention fixed.

derivation.justification: Find minimal rotation between consecutive tangents.
Transport normal and rebuild orthonormal frame.
Convert stable frame to camera orientation.

assumptions: Tangents nonzero; antiparallel case uses fallback axis.
records.result: Parallel transport stabilizes camera orientation along a curve by minimizing twist.
limits: Cusps and zero tangents require regularization.

checks: 16/16 técnicas cubiertas, incluidas dos investigaciones R31.
Cada derivación contiene pasos matemáticos justificados, supuestos y límites.
Se separan proyección, orientación, trayectoria, óptica, temporalidad y continuidad narrativa.
limitations: Los modelos ópticos simplificados no sustituyen trazado físico de lentes; validación visual posterior.
